dmzlivingworld.screen.guide.title: Living World — Guide
dmzlivingworld.screen.guide.chapter.gett: Living World adds persistent Dragon Mine Z fighters who live, grow and remember what happens.
* Fighter Interact + Right-click a Living World fighter — open their character panel.
* Talk, travel and shared experiences build personal relationships over time.
* Fighters can train, fight, join factions, form bonds and pursue their own goals.
dmzlivingworld.screen.guide.chapter.peop: * People shows fighters your character knows and the last information you learned about them.
* Fighter Interact + Right-click shows their identity, story, combat information and actions.
* Friends may travel, meditate or fight beside you depending on the situation and their personality.
* Remembered fighters can be used for Instant Transmission when your Dragon Mine Z skill can reach them.
dmzlivingworld.screen.guide.chapter.fact: Work that exists for a reason
* Factions remember your reputation and may treat you differently from individual members.
* Requests appear only when a faction currently needs outside help.
* Factions → Active Quest always shows who issued your current request.
* The active quest HUD gives live direction, progress and the next objective.
* Supply requests name the exact receiver and exact items needed.
dmzlivingworld.screen.guide.chapter.trav: * Go Along lets you accompany something a fighter is already doing.
* Come Along asks a fighter to travel with you for a while.
* Travelling fighters use their real movement and flight abilities and can defend themselves naturally.
* L → Companion manages your current travelling companion.
dmzlivingworld.screen.guide.chapter.fusi: * Fighter Interact + Right-click → Fusion starts a compatible Fusion Dance with that fighter.
* Normal Dragon Mine Z requirements, power limits and cooldowns still apply.
* Friendly fighters can sometimes meditate with you, and deeper meditation can provide configured training rewards.
dmzlivingworld.screen.guide.chapter.npc_: NPC Objectives
Helping a fighter reach their goal
Every remembered or faction-affiliated fighter can be pursuing one personal goal at a time. Their character panel shows the current goal and its progress under Story.
## Defeat a Rival
. Rivalries form on their own through repeated encounters; you cannot create or assign one directly.
. The fighter seeks their rival out on their own once both are nearby and available. Just give them the opportunity to meet.
## Learn a New Technique
. Techniques are copied from another fighter's real Ki skill after a genuine fight or rivalry moment.
. Bring the fighter near other capable fighters and let natural encounters happen; this resolves on its own.
## Acquire Equipment
. The goal names a specific real item the fighter is missing (weapon, armor, etc.).
. Gift them the exact named item through Fighter Interact + Right-click to complete this instantly.
. They may also find and pick up a matching dropped item on their own given enough time.
## Advance Racial Training
. This is racial form training (Super Saiyan, Namekian, Majin, Frost Demon, Bio-Android and similar lines) progressing toward their next unlock level.
. Both training sessions and meditation count toward it. Encourage or accompany them while they train or meditate; the unlock itself happens automatically over time.
## Learn to Fly
. Flight unlocks permanently after enough real training sessions.
. Training and meditation both count. No direct action is required beyond giving them time to train.
## Win Meaningful Fights
. Counts real wins against other fighters, whether in the wild, a sanctioned Spar, or faction conflict.
. Sparring the fighter yourself, or letting them fight naturally, both make progress.
## Defeat a Fighter Above a PL
. The fighter is watching for a genuinely stronger opponent worth challenging.
. This is entirely something the fighter resolves on their own by encountering and defeating a strong enough target.
## Perform Another Fusion
. Offer Fusion yourself through Fighter Interact + Right-click if you are compatible, or let them fuse with another NPC naturally over time.
## Complete Serious Training Sessions
. Any real training or meditation session counts toward the total.
. Accompanying them with Go Along while they train, or simply giving them time, completes this goal.
. If a fighter currently has no goal listed, they are between ambitions and will pick a new one on their own.
dmzlivingworld.screen.guide.chapter.cont: * Fighter Interact + Right-click — inspect a fighter (the modifier is configurable).
* World Config. controls gameplay rules; Display settings control your own HUD and visual preferences.
